leads.name: negative wage/rate admission
leads.observation: RecordDailyWage accepts signed nullable custom wage or stored DailyWage with no positivity guard before credit posting; overtime only Hours<=0 guard, no custom rate sign/finite product bounds; extra shift only ShiftCount positive, fallback stored wage can be negative.
leads.impact: Can post negative employee earning or invalid arithmetic if admitted by actual DTO/endpoint/client path; authorized writer, not permission bypass.
leads.next: Read request and endpoints, trace stored employee input validation, then pure arithmetic/guard probe if useful.

leads.name: manual ledger unknown enum and replay identity
leads.observation: Enum.TryParse(ignoreCase:true) alone permits numeric undefined underlying values; canonical ToString is still numeric. Manual request generates fresh GUID for each invocation and lacks deterministic key in handler.
leads.impact: Potential unbucketed ledger category and repeat records after lost response; enum member existence and retry contract require specific verification.
leads.next: Check DTO RequestId absence, endpoint behavior and any middleware duplicate-request policy before promotion.

leads.name: concurrent cached BalanceAfter
leads.observation: Manual writer reads balance before implicit SaveChanges transaction, shared Poster does not lock or start transaction. Wage/overtime/extra shift wrappers have no explicit transaction or employee anchor lock.
leads.impact: Two distinct successful credits can each store BalanceAfter omitting sibling while fact totals remain correct; do not claim actual double spending from cached display risk alone.
leads.counterevidence: PayEmployee has real employee anchor/range locks; same deterministic daily key rejected by PK, distinct-key race needed.
leads.next: Trace attendance and manual writer interleavings plus DB isolation; no SQL test authorized.
